blocks.text: Nehemiah 7 contains 73 verses. It opens with: Now it came to pass, when the wall was built, and I had set up the doors, and the porters and the singers and the Levites were appointed, It concludes with: So the priests, and the Levites, and the porters, and the singers, and some of the people, and the Nethinim, and all Israel, dwelt in their cities. And when the seventh month was come, the children of Israel were in their cities.
